description: Two more small query languages, judged the same way SQL is: composition is what separates a value being searched FOR from a filter the caller wrote. The bound route passes the caller's text whole as the filter argument and is silent, which is the same reasoning that keeps a parameterized SQL call silent -- and is a stated miss when the whole filter really is the caller's.

expected.note: the caller's text is built into the filter
the caller's text is built into the expression
